message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` shows 1 test, 1 pass, 0 fail.

**Cause:** The DBA-owned migration `migrations/001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, with no underscore. `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`, so the insert failed with `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`, which is the name the production schema uses. The change is only in that file.

I did not touch `migrations/`. If the intent was to rename the column to `full_name`, that needs a new migration from the DBA team, not an edit to the existing ones.
